title: Hyper-Transforming Latent Diffusion Models

summary: Normalized-weight vanishing explanation is mathematically incorrect; released CSV repeats cumulative metric arrays. No demonstrated error in published benchmark scores.
limitations: No author code execution or empirical reproduction.

problems.claim: Page 5 following Eq. (8): normalization near zero hypothesized to make weights and their gradients vanish.
problems.location: PDF p.5, Sec.3.2.1, Eq.(8) and following paragraph
assumptions: b=(1,1), u=(r,0), r>0; no global training claim made
problems.check: Analytic derivative: D_u R=(I-vhat vhat^T)diag(b)/||v||. Independent finite formula evaluations also run.
problems.result: Output=(1,0), norm1; Jacobian diag(0,1/r), transverse derivative diverges as r→0.
counterevidence: Authors frame mechanism as a hypothesis.
Radial derivative is zero; downstream loss directions can vanish.
An epsilon denominator floor changes near-zero output but has nonvanishing linear-region Jacobian.
problems.impact: Local mechanism error. Eq.(9) and empirical performance are not refuted; no core performance dependency demonstrated.

correction.statement: Normalization removes radial scale and is singular/poorly conditioned near zero; scale modulation at u=0 preserves b with derivative diag(b).
correction.verification: Analytic local identities proved; global optimization effect unverified

problems.claim: Released ImageMetrics.run saves calculated image metrics in CSV.
assumptions: File treated as ordinary rows of one evaluation
Synthetic scalar metric inputs illustrate only serialization
problems.check: Read accumulation and append logic statically. Independently calculated multiplicity B-j+1 and synthetic two-batch rows.
problems.result: PSNR inputs10,30 produce rows10,10,30; naive mean16.6667 vs intended20. Prefix FIDs5,3 serialize5,3,3.
counterevidence: Final in-memory means can be correct.
Final appended block alone contains proper full-set PSNRs and final FID.
problems.impact: Released output defect; effect on published Tables1-4 Needs Evidence.

correction.statement: For fresh file, write complete PSNR array once after loop and final global FID separately.
correction.verification: Serialization arithmetic justified; author program not modified or run

unresolved_claims.reason: No run configuration/checkpoint/raw metric output binding identifies which code and aggregation generated Tables1-4.
Same-run identity not established; difference not graded as error.
